_comment: Every tool that declares flow.steps (a Flow's call step may run it), with the guard it relies on inside the tool: the check it makes on the person's chain (ctx.kernel.chain(meta)). The runner does not ask the kernel about a Flow tool, so the tool must gate itself. A flow step with no line here, a line that names no guard, or a stale line fails test/flow-step-guards.test.js.

work.start-project.reason: runs under the Flow person's own chain (ctx.kernel.chainFor): the project is made, updated and its team added with that person's grants, a draft or retired template version cannot be started, and the first stage's tasks are made by the stage module as that person's service

comms.send.reason: holds every send at the Gate for the person's own yes: an email goes through mail.send and a text through gate.request, both asked of the person on the call's chain, so a Flow cannot send anything the person has not approved

documents.generate.reason: opens the Space through lib/gateway-door.js, which refuses a call that proved no person; the kernel's grants on that person's chain decide which template, records and Drive path may be read and written

documents.signed-link.reason: opens the Space through lib/gateway-door.js, which refuses a call that proved no person; the kernel's grants on that person's chain decide whether the signed copy's link may be made, and the link it makes is signed and expires

documents.send.reason: opens the Space through lib/gateway-door.js, which refuses a call that proved no person; the kernel's grants on that person's chain decide the signing request, and the email that carries the link goes through comms.send, held at the Gate for the person's yes

documents.send-signed.reason: opens the Space through lib/gateway-door.js, which refuses a call that proved no person; the kernel's grants on that person's chain decide the signed link, and the email that carries it goes through comms.send, held at the Gate for the person's yes
